exercises.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: two-frame exercise motion sprite sheet for Gym Tracker. EXACTLY TWO EQUAL SQUARE PANELS side by side; 2:1 landscape canvas. NO divider, no text, labels, arrows or ghost limbs. Will be cut EXACTLY in half and alternated like GIF. One full athlete and full machine in EACH panel. Input image is reference for same character, clothing, exercise equipment and clean flat illustration style. Sage green tank top, dark green shorts, white trainers, short dark brown hair, crisp dark outlines, flat subtle shading. Uniform very pale blue #EDF2FF background and faint floor shadow. CRITICAL ALIGNMENT: Copy same camera, equipment geometry, scale, subject framing and all stationary landmarks at precisely identical relative coordinates in each panel. Only moving joints, attached handles and weights change. Do not recenter each pose separately! Frame for widest/tallest of both poses with generous shared margins; no cropped limbs, machine, dumbbells or plates. Correct coherent anatomy, two arms and two legs only. Assisted pull-up on a gravitron machine, three-quarter REAR view. Both hands grip the same fixed overhead pull-up handles at exactly the same coordinates in both panels. LEFT: arms extended overhead, torso lowered, both bent knees resting on assistance pad. RIGHT: elbows flexed pulling torso up until chin is near handle height, knees and pad rise with torso. Frame and overhead handles remain immobile. Knees must remain on pad in both positions, not seated. Full machine visible, enough headroom.
